title: Employment Agreement - James Carter
text: 12.1 Non-Competition. For twelve (12) months after termination of employment, Employee shall not provide substantially similar enterprise-sales services to a direct competitor within fifty (50) miles of the Company's Westbridge office.

title: Restrictive Covenant - Preliminary Legal Analysis
text: Carter worked with national accounts, which weakens Northstar's argument that a fifty-mile radius tracks the actual competitive risk. A court could narrow or decline to enforce the geographic restriction while still protecting confidential information and specific customer relationships.

title: Preliminary Injunction Hearing Notes
text: Judge Maren stated that the twelve-month duration did not appear facially excessive, but repeatedly questioned why a fifty-mile geographic limit made sense for an employee who serviced national accounts.

title: Settlement Agreement and Mutual Release
text: Northstar agrees that Carter may remain employed by Vertex Metrics LLC and will not seek enforcement of Section 12.1 solely on the basis of that employment.

title: Maria Lopez Performance Reviews
text: Overall rating: Meets Expectations. Lopez was praised for accuracy and knowledge of payer rules. Development note: improve timeliness when escalating disputed accounts.

title: Internal Investigation Notes
text: Compliance confirmed that 22 of the 37 encounters identified by Lopez contained duplicate billing entries caused by a batch-processing configuration error. The duplicates were reversed before final collection on 18 encounters; four had already generated patient statements.

title: Retaliation Claim Risk Assessment
text: The strongest plaintiff evidence is temporal proximity combined with Ross's account of Mills's 'unnecessary attention' comment. Meridian's strongest defense is the January supervisor note and documented missed deadlines during the PIP.

title: Employee Confidentiality and Invention Assignment Agreement
text: Nothing in this Agreement prohibits Employee from working for a competitor, provided Employee does not use or disclose Arcadia Confidential Information.

title: Security Access Log Summary
text: A removable drive was connected on January 3. System logs show 214 files copied during the session, including calibration tables and VehiclePath-X design notes.

title: Stipulated Temporary Injunction Order
text: The Order does not prohibit Patel from remaining employed by NovaMotion Systems, provided his work does not use Arcadia protected information.

title: Neutral Examiner Report
text: The removable drive contained 214 Arcadia files matching the January 3 copy event. File access metadata indicates that eleven documents were opened after Patel began employment at NovaMotion.

title: Document Retention Policy
text: Unless a client-specific instruction or legal hold requires longer retention, ordinary closed matter files are retained for seven years after the matter closing date.

title: Client Confidentiality and Access Control Policy
text: Any internal AI or retrieval system must enforce matter-level authorization before client content is supplied to a model or external service.

title: Legal Research and Citation Guidelines
text: AI-generated summaries may assist issue spotting but are not themselves legal authority. Material propositions must be traced to and verified against the original source.
